title: Writer's studio
brief: Flat-desk WorkstationGroup near the window, beige daybed, low stocked bookshelf, plants, framed prints, sheer curtains; laptop + rotary phone carry the vintage cue (no typewriter mesh exists).
verdict: CONVERGED after the 2026-07-14 region-separation fix (desk → back-right third, shelf → back wall, window → back-right, so the left-wall daybed keeps circulation): no rotation, no wall overlap.
